where a workers' strike turned into a deadly trap when the apocalypse began.
WILDSTEEL is a custom map for Project Zomboid Build 42, located at a highway intersection south of Louisville Airport.
Before the Knox Event, a group of former Spiffoland employees organized a strike and blocked the road using cars, banners, and improvised camps.
Today the area has become a graveyard of abandoned vehicles, zombies, and mechanical loot, making it a perfect location for survivors looking for cars, parts, and fuel.
After a wave of layoffs at Spiffoland, several workers decided to block a major highway intersection as a form of protest.
The plan was simple: stop traffic until someone listened.
But the Knox Event arrived first.
Panic, crashes, and abandoned vehicles quickly filled the crossroads.
The protesters disappeared… or became something worse.
Now WILDSTEEL stands as a rusting metal graveyard and a new opportunity for survivors brave enough to explore it.
• Large amount of abandoned cars to scrap
• A gas station as a strategic location
Nature has started reclaiming the area.
Perfect for hunting and survival gameplay in Build 42.
The map blends naturally with nearby vanilla roads.
• Players who enjoy vehicle collecting and scrapping
WILDSTEEL is a small but dense location focused on vehicles, exploration, and mechanical survival gameplay.
If you enjoy maps full of cars, scrap opportunities, and places to build a mechanic base, this crossroads might become one of your favorite spots in Project Zomboid B42.

modInfo: Originally named "Liu Ba Tou," Willowbrook Bastion! served as the station for the 7th Regiment of the 3rd Brigade of the New Fourth Army's 1st Division during the Anti-Japanese War. Hu Shiyan, editor of the regiment's Combat News, wrote the novel The Story of Willowbrook Bastion! here, depicting the close bond between the military and civilians. The story was later adapted into a film of the same name, leading to the town's renaming as "Willowbrook Bastion!."
